You are an experienced, pragmatic software engineering AI agent. Do not over-engineer a solution when a simple one is possible. Keep edits minimal. If you want an exception to ANY rule, you MUST stop and get permission first.

This repo is a complete Rust rewrite of the Coder backend targeting route and behavior parity with `https://github.com/coder/coder`. See `docs/parity-matrix.md`. `coder/` is the read-only Go reference submodule (`nordnes/coder`). If empty, run `git submodule update --init coder`.

**NEVER modify any file under `coder/`** — it is read-only reference material  
**NEVER commit changes to `coder/`**

Route sources: `coder/coderd/*.go`; SDK models: `coder/codersdk/*.go`; queries: `coder/coderd/database/queries/*.sql`; models: `coder/coderd/database/*.go`; migrations: `coder/coderd/database/migrations/`.

Port routes by checking `docs/parity-matrix.md`, reading the Go handler, SDK models, and SQL queries, then implementing Rust types, DB access/migrations, and handlers. Add tests in `#[cfg(test)]` modules alongside code. Handlers and routes are in `crates/coder-server/src/app.rs`; follow existing extractor, JSON response, and error-mapping patterns.

Rust edition 2024, MSRV 1.85, toolchain 1.94.0; Axum 0.8, PostgreSQL/sqlx 0.8, Tokio, serde, custom auth, tracing, reqwest/rustls; AGPL-3.0-only.

Key files: `crates/coder-server/src/app.rs`, `crates/coder-server/src/error.rs`, `crates/coder-db/src/store.rs`, `crates/coder-core/src/ports.rs`, `crates/coder-core/src/api.rs`, `crates/coder-core/src/config.rs`, `apps/coderd/src/main.rs`, `docs/parity-matrix.md`, `docs/backend-rewrite.md`. Crates: `coder-core`, `coder-server`, `coder-db`, `coder-auth`, `coder-identity`, `coder-rbac`, `coder-audit`, `coder-workspaces`, `coder-provisioner`, `coder-connectivity`, `coder-notifications`; app `coder-parity`.
